## Goal
Rebuild every product from scratch as a premium, production-hosted SIR project, in a studied order: finish PERSONAL and PRIVATE rounds already queued, then SIR AI (the manager's replacement), then the other GLOBAL products. First income milestone: real and measured via SIR Jobs (researches what a Vibe Coder can truly earn, applies with one-tap approval, reports real numbers). HQ prepares and keeps this plan; one chat per project folder builds.

All web products need: the Cloudflare and Firebase logins. SIR Platform was cancelled as a project on 2026-11-12 (owner decision): it is a shared standards kit, `plans/SHARED_PLATFORM_KIT.md`, and every product ships on all platforms (web, Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS). Shared concerns (owner-auth, signed-webhook, billing fallback, ai-proxy, legal pack, tokens and UI) are kept as internal packages in each product. SIR Portfolio is built from the finished products. **Every GLOBAL product has: own Firebase project, own GitHub repo named exactly after the product, owner-only analytics page, dual hosting (Firebase + Vercel), subscription grants owner all permissions, competitor matrix, feature parity with best-in-category, SHARED_PLATFORM_KIT reuse.**

## How every project chat works
1. Read `D:/Projects/_SIR/NEXT.md`, this file, your project's `.sir/CHECKPOINT.md` and `.sir/TASKS.md`; your first task is a deep scan of `legacy/` and the plan, then you improve the plan.
2. Your project folder has the kit: PLAN, TASKS, BOARD, ARCHITECTURE, DESIGN, PLATFORMS, PRODUCTION, QUALITY, BENCHMARK, TEAM, TOOLKIT. Use your sub-agents (TEAM.md) and tools (TOOLKIT.md); install more when they help, vetted, free.
3. Use the computer for any task: `plans/COMPUTER_USE.md`. Work out how yourself; never hand Ahmed steps. Quality checklist and quota hand-over: `D:/Projects/GEMINI.md`.
4. Commit and push straight to `main` when `verify` passes. No pull requests. Never delete `legacy/`.
5. Talk to other projects: durable messages in `D:/Projects/_SIR/ops/bus/<slug>.md` (see `ops/bus/README.md`), live with ListAgents and SendMessage. Ask for what you need from a project that provides it; tell a project when you change something it depends on.
6. Dashboards: `D:/Projects/_SIR/mods` holds Ahmed's dashboard mods (SIR Context, SIR Guards; the Control Room dashboard itself lives in `plans/generate_dashboard.py` + `ops/public/`, not as a mod). Improve them when something is missing, or add a pane or dashboard for your project as a new mod there (register it in `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`, `claude plugin install <name>@sir-mods`). Keep the shared ones generic.
7. End (and after every finished step): update `.sir/CHECKPOINT.md` (Now, Next step with the exact command, Open promises, Re-read), one line in `_SIR/ops/MISSION_LOG.md`, commit and push to `main`.

## Privacy and safety lines
AHome and everything about Habiba never leave AHome. API keys may be created, rotated and deleted by agents; no secrets in git. Owner-only checks run on the server. Only Ahmed: sign-in, passkey and 2FA, CAPTCHA, payments, typing secrets into forms.
